title: LOGS Tab Cross-Source Correlated Timeline
problem: Events from different log sources were still shown grouped by source, making it hard to correlate incidents across heterogeneous timestamp formats.
root_cause: LogParser returned independent LogSource arrays with no cross-source timestamp normalization, unified sort, or merged deduplication.
fix_summary: Added LogTimelineMode, tolerant parseLineTimestamp, unifiedLines merge/sort/dedup, Sources/Timeline segmented picker, unified timeline view with source chips + timestamp + event/level badges, and Copy/Export actions. Added timestamp and unified-timeline tests.
